title: Recursive junta learner
statement: Let $n,k$ be natural numbers, let a relevant coordinate finder be given for these parameters, and choose a rational failure parameter in $(0,1/2]$. The learner is the randomized-example program obtained by running the recursive construction with fuel $k$, starting with no fixed coordinates and allocating the per-call failure parameter prescribed by the learner’s failure-allocation rule; its output, when present, is a decision tree on all $n$ coordinates.
caveat: The payload does not provide the definitions of the failure-allocation rule or the empty fixed assignment, so those implementation details cannot be rendered more precisely.
